```sql
with fx as (
    select c.rate_date,
           c.currency,
           cast(c.usd_per_unit / r.usd_per_unit as decimal(38,12)) as to_reporting
    from fx_rates c
    join fx_rates r on r.rate_date = c.rate_date and r.currency = 'INR'
),
duplicate_captured_orders as (
    select distinct a.order_id
    from payment_attempts a
    join orders o on o.order_id = a.order_id
    join showrooms s on s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
    where not a.is_test
      and not o.is_test
      and a.status = 'captured'
      and s.region_id = 'IN-TN'
    group by a.order_id, a.amount_minor
    having count(*) >= 2
)
select cast(NULL as varchar) as key,
       cast(coalesce(round(sum(rf.amount_minor * fx.to_reporting)), 0) as bigint) as value
from refunds rf
join orders o on o.order_id = rf.order_id
join showrooms s on s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
join duplicate_captured_orders d on d.order_id = rf.order_id
join fx on fx.currency = rf.currency and fx.rate_date = rf.business_date
where not o.is_test
  and rf.status = 'processed'
  and s.region_id = 'IN-TN'
  and rf.business_date between date '2026-08-01' and date '2026-08-31'
order by value
```
